cohort: 110 pregnant women with a hypertensive disorder of pregnancy (gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, or eclampsia) at ≥34 weeks gestation
finding: There was a significant correlation between maternal serum uric acid levels, disease severity, and maternal outcome in women with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy.
mod_finding: In women with serum uric acid >6mg/dl, the most common mode of delivery was a lower segment cesarean section.
